_doc: Per-agent write boundaries, enforced by hooks/guard.sh (keyed by the agent's `name`). Add a block here for every new agent; no shell editing needed. deny_write_paths: substrings an Edit/Write/Bash-write may never touch. allow_write_paths: if present, Edit/Write may ONLY touch paths containing one of these. deny_bash_patterns: extended regexes refused in Bash commands. reason: shown when blocked.

research-analyst.reason: the research-analyst agent proposes data sources, it doesn't implement them. Hand the approved candidate to the add-data-source skill in a normal session instead.

criteria-proposer.reason: the criteria-proposer only writes research/ (ledger rows and memos); it never touches code, the registry's decisions, or artifacts.
